title: Dwarf French Bean Slenderette - 2x Plug Plants - Disease Resistant
description:
Dwarf French Bean Slenderette - 2x Plug Plants - Disease Resistant                     
Enjoy a heavy crop of delicious green beans with minimal effort! Our 'Slenderette' Dwarf French Bean plug plants are the perfect choice for an easy, rewarding harvest.  Get a significant head start by skipping the germination stage. You will receive healthy, established plug plants, ready to go straight into your garden, raised beds, or large containers.  'Slenderette' is a highly reliable and popular dwarf variety, known for producing an abundance of long, slender, and stringless green pods with an excellent flavour. Its compact, bushy habit makes it ideal for any garden size.
